name: stack_ready_in_a_wave
description: Waves stack in High Water and truly overlap (contract-m8 §2, design 2.7, the owner's decision of 2 November 2026): a present seat's Ready during wave 1 is taken (EV_READY, no refusal), and the stacked horn sounds on the tick it lands, with nine of wave 1's ten Gourdlings still to come (EV_WAVE start with stacked), every Ready cleared and both waves on the road. Wave 2's first Gourdling sets out on the horn's tick, as at a window's horn, and the rest at its 27-tick interval, while wave 1 keeps its own 54-tick schedule from its own horn, untouched: the Welling sends both. Solo, no towers, so every creep is still on the road.

steps.assert: scene.client(1).hollows[0].phase == 1 and scene.client(1).waves_on_road(0) == PackedInt32Array([1]) and scene.client(1).can_stack(0)
steps.msg: wave 1 walks alone and the hollow can take another
nine of wave 1's Gourdlings are still to come
the Ready during the wave is taken, on tick 30
the stacked horn calls wave 2 on the tick the Ready lands, with wave 1 still setting out

steps.assert: scene.client(1).waves_on_road(0) == PackedInt32Array([1, 2]) and not scene.client(1).seat(1).ready and scene.client(1).hollows[0].wave == 2 and scene.client(1).hollows[0].cleared == 0
steps.msg: both waves on the road, the Ready cleared, wave 2 the newest called
wave 2's first Gourdling sets out on the horn's tick, of wave 2
wave 1's nine still to come wait beside wave 2's seventeen

steps.assert: gaps == [54, 27] and w1.size() == 10 and w1[9] == [9 * gaps[0], 'gourdling'] and w1[5] == [5 * gaps[0], 'gourdling']
steps.msg: wave 1 set out on its own schedule from its own horn, as if nothing were stacked

steps.assert: w2.size() == 18 and w2[17] == [17 * gaps[1], 'gourdling'] and w2[8] == [8 * gaps[1], 'gourdling']
steps.msg: wave 2 on its own, from the stacked horn
